assumptions.statement: Overall and key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-dependent design layers and metrics require recalculation when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Replace site_boundary and key_areas, regenerate dependent geometry, figures, PDFs and HTML, then rerun all checks.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, redlines, setbacks, ownership, utilities, fire and heritage controls are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity, engineering feasibility, ownership or demolition conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Cycling breaks, shade, service condition, actual users and operating responsibilities require field observation and stakeholder confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Pilot targets are set after a four-week manual baseline, not invented in advance.

assumptions.statement: Staffing numbers cover one short pilot segment and one station only.
assumptions.impact: Final staff, budget, procurement and partner commitments require local negotiation and lawful procedures.

assumptions.statement: The four readiness gates are a proposed decision protocol; no site permission, accountable operator, budget, procurement route, partnership or professional approval is represented as confirmed.
assumptions.impact: The pilot may not enter baseline work without recorded site, responsibility and resource gates, and may not test fixed facilities, health services or real-data processing without the applicable professional and safety gate.
